creation.prompt: Edit ONLY the eyes/eyelids/brows and local facial tension of reference 1, the owner-selected Milo S07 portrait base. Anxiously explaining the shortcut and wanting to get home before dark: inner brows gently lifted, worried concentration, earnest eyes looking up-left toward offscreen Leo, tense but closed mouth, no happy smile. Keep EXACT head pose/angle, skull/muzzle, eye size and spacing, ears/whiskers and cream muzzle, neck/shoulders/upper-chest silhouette, visible body extent, crop and image canvas. No zoom, head lift, body rebuild, mirroring or new anatomy. Reference 2 owns canonical identity/material/palette; reference 3 supplies that character's own projected surface guides, not new targets. Preserve intrinsic felt colors and texture. Closed mouth at still boundary despite dialogue; no teeth or speech mouth. Genuine transparent alpha, no environment, props, captions, symbols, shadows or watermark. One output only. A reference constrains generation but does not prove exact pixel identity; preserve surrounding body as closely as possible.
